about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Evoque D165 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Evoque D165 has been part of the Range Rover Evoque range since 2016, using the Ingenium AJ200D and AJ150D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine family shared across the Discovery Sport and Evoque platform. It replaced earlier D150 and D180 badges when the diesel range was simplified in 2020, but the underlying engine family remains the same across both the L538 and L551 generations. The D165 sits between the entry-level D150 and the higher-output D180 in the diesel lineup, offering a balanced combination of efficiency and performance that appeals to a wide range of Evoque owners. Range Rover Evoque D165 Engine Codes Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the Evoque D165 across the L538 and L551 generations. The AJ200D and AJ150D are closely related variants of the same Ingenium diesel family, with the D165 badge representing the 163PS power output level. Known for timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, tensioner, guides, injector seals, EGR components, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover Evoque D165 from 2023 to present. The Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D rebuild.
